heroHeadline: Zelensky Publishes Open Letter to Putin Proposing Ceasefire + Bilateral Meeting; Ukraine Strikes St. Petersburg Oil Terminal, Caspian Sea Rigs, Novocherkassk Power Plant; Russia Deploys New Geran-5 Drone
heroSubtitle: On Day 1,562 (June 5, 2026), Ukraine is simultaneously conducting some of the most dramatic offensive operations of the war while pursuing diplomatic overtures. On June 4, President Zelensky published an unprecedented open letter directly addressed to Vladimir Putin, proposing an immediate ceasefire along the current frontline, a face-to-face bilateral meeting in a neutral country (Switzerland, Turkey, or the Arab world), and an all-for-all prisoner exchange. The Kremlin deflected, saying Putin 'can come to Moscow any time.' On June 3, Ukrainian drones struck St. Petersburg's oil terminal and the guided-missile corvette Boikiy in dry dock at Kronstadt naval base — on the opening day of Putin's flagship SPIEF economic forum — with Russia claiming 354 drones intercepted overnight. On June 5, Ukrainian drones struck three Lukoil oil drilling rigs in the Caspian Sea (unprecedented offshore strike), the Novocherkassk Thermal Power Plant in Rostov Oblast (causing a regional Russian blackout), and destroyed a Buk-M3 air defense system in Luhansk. Russia struck Odesa's energy grid, leaving 33,500 without power. Russia also deployed the new Geran-5 jet-powered drone (90 kg warhead, 1,000 km range). The UK announced development of a new ballistic missile for Ukraine. Russian cumulative losses reached approximately 1,369,340 personnel by June 4.
footerNote: Data sourced from UN OHCHR, ISW, CSIS, Ukrainian MoD, US DoD, NATO, IAEA, EU Council, UK MoD, and major news outlets including Reuters, BBC, AP, Al Jazeera, Bloomberg, Kyiv Independent, Ukrinform, Ukrainska Pravda, ABC News, NPR, CNN, CBS News, Times of Israel, Time, PBS NewsHour, RBC Ukraine, Militarnyi, Kyiv Post, The Moscow Times, France 24, CBC, Russia Matters, and the Ukrainian General Staff. Casualty figures are estimates; Russia has never released official figures.
